title: Is Bitcoin A Hedge Against Central Banking? Evidence from AI-Driven Monetary Policy Expectations
abstract: arXiv:2604.08825v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This study investigates the transmission of monetary policy narratives to Bitcoin prices, distinguishing policy expectations from realized policy implementation. We introduce a weekly Monetary Policy Expectations (MPE) index derived from the Large Language Model (LLM)-based classification of 118,000+ market messages, providing a granular measure of hawkish and dovish monetary policy discourse. We demonstrate that changes in the MPE index provide evidence of significant linear predictive information for Bitcoin returns at short-to-medium horizons, with significant Granger causality at multiple lags. A Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) framework combined with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) further identifies nonlinear and regime-dependent relationships between monetary-policy expectations and Bitcoin returns, indicating that Bitcoin functions as a sensitive barometer of central bank signaling. translated_title: 比特币是对冲中央银行政策的工具吗？来自AI驱动的货币政策预期的证据
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了货币政策叙事向比特币价格的传导机制，并区分了政策预期与实际政策实施。我们引入了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）分类的每周货币政策预期（MPE）指数，该指数基于118,000多条市场消息，提供了对鹰派和鸽派货币政策论述的细粒度度量。我们证明，MPE指数的变化在短期至中期范围内为比特币收益提供了显著的线性预测信息，并在多个滞后期上表现出显著的格兰杰因果关系。结合长短期记忆（LSTM）框架和SHapley加性解释（SHAP）方法，进一步识别了货币政策预期与比特币收益之间的非线性和制度依赖关系，表明比特币作为中央银行信号传递的敏感晴雨表。特别是，鹰派货币政策预期对比特币价格产生了显著影响。
tldr: 该研究首次利用AI驱动的货币政策预期指数，证明比特币对央行政策信号具有敏感的预测性反应，且这种关系呈非线性和制度依赖性。
en_tdlr: This study introduces an AI-driven monetary policy expectations index, demonstrating that Bitcoin exhibits sensitive, nonlinear, and regime-dependent predictive responses to central bank signaling.
